// Generated by `krs emit-k` from krs, tour-nat-functions. Do not edit; edit the Rust sources and emit again.
// The `// KRS <package>/<file>: <item>` line above a sentence names the Rust item it comes from.
// A default label spells that item's path: `<namespace>--<module>--…--<item>`.
// Mutations of this K are patches in the corpus's mutations/<topic>.toml (kink/ beside Cargo.toml by default), each edit anchored by `rule = <label>`;
// `krs kink check` resolves them and shows each edit's Rust line. Why K patches, not Rust edits: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/k-rust/blob/main/kink/decisions.md#m-mutation-input

module KRS-FRAMEWORK
  syntax KItem
  syntax KResult

  syntax KItem ::= KResult
endmodule

module NAT-SYNTAX
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK

  syntax Nat

  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: NatSyntax::Succ { n }
  syntax Nat ::= "s" "(" Nat ")" [symbol(natSyntaxSucc), format(%1%2%3%4)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: NatSyntax::Zero
  syntax Nat ::= "zero" [symbol(natSyntaxZero), format(%1)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: Plus
  // `plus(m, n)` is the sum of `m` and `n`.
  syntax Nat ::= "plus" "(" Nat "," Nat ")" [symbol(plus), function, total]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: Pred
  // `pred(n)` is the number before `n`; no equation constrains `pred(zero)`.
  syntax Nat ::= "pred" "(" Nat ")" [symbol(pred), function]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: Times
  // `times(m, n)` is the product of `m` and `n`.
  syntax Nat ::= "times" "(" Nat "," Nat ")" [symbol(times), function, total]
endmodule

module NAT
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK
  imports NAT-SYNTAX

  syntax KItem ::= Nat

  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: Machine
  configuration
    <k> $PGM:Nat </k>


  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: plus_succ
  rule plus ( s ( M:Nat ) , N:Nat ) => s ( plus ( M:Nat , N:Nat ) ) [label(nat--plus_succ)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: plus_zero
  rule plus ( zero , N:Nat ) => N:Nat [label(nat--plus_zero)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: pred_succ
  rule pred ( s ( N:Nat ) ) => N:Nat [label(nat--pred_succ)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: times_succ
  rule times ( s ( M:Nat ) , N:Nat ) => plus ( N:Nat , times ( M:Nat , N:Nat ) ) [label(nat--times_succ)]
  // KRS tour-nat-functions/src/lib.rs: times_zero
  rule times ( zero , _ ) => zero [label(nat--times_zero)]
endmodule
